titles.title: Bone Marrow Radiation Shielding Act
Bone Marrow Radiation Shielding Act

To direct the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Nuclear, Chemical, and Biological Defense, Policy and Programs to seek to enter into an agreement with a University Affiliated Research Center affiliated with United States Strategic Command to conduct an independent scientific assessment with respect to bone marrow radiation shielding for nuclear survivability.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Armed Services.
